detail: S&P and Dow close in correction. NVDA -14%, MU -14%, AMD -13%, AVGO -12%, TSM -9.5%. Bitcoin below $59k. UMich sentiment 51.5. Fed's Cook warns against waiting to hike.
Still above the $83 IPO price. 2x Anthropic ETFs from Tradr were due to start Nov 23. DayOne Data Centers put its US IPO on hold (reported).
First close below 5,000 since June; week -4.9%. Seatrium -8.8%, SATS -5.3%, Venture -3.3%, SGX -3.1%, Keppel -3.1%.

event: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
detail: Unanimous board vote; an independent-director probe continues. NVDA +31.5% to ~$165, adding nearly $1T. Chips +10-25%; SanDisk fell 7%.
Best day since April 2025. VIX ~27. 10-yr 4.94%, dollar at a 19-month high, WTI ~$80.8 (-3%), gold +4%. Markets price ~91% odds of a Dec 9 hike.

event: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler (~$43.9B, all stock)
detail: 1.135 CRWD shares per ZS share; ZS +16%, CRWD -10%. Applied Digital +23% on a ~$5.4B lease. Jefferies starts SpaceX at Buy ($210).
Closed before the US rally. Marco Polo Marine -9.5% on lower FY profit guidance; AEM +5.5%, CSE Global +7.1%. October core inflation eased to 1.5%.
Dell, HP, Workday and Deere report this week; HPE and Zoom reported after Monday's close.

event: October PCE inflation; Q3 GDP second estimate
detail: First GDP estimate was 3.4%. Key input for the Dec 9 Fed decision.
US stock market closed; early close (1pm ET) on Nov 27.
A hike is widely expected. Broadcom reports the same day.
